title: Build Quality into Processes and Deliverables
coreMove: Quality is built when teams define fitness for use, prevent defects in the workflow, and let those standards guide tradeoffs under pressure.

exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may blame testers instead of the process that created the defects
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: trace a signoff defect pattern back to skipped prevention work

exampleSpecs.stakes: a status note may hide a weak acceptance standard
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show the mental shift from schedule defense to quality evidence

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads allocating scarce review time
exampleSpecs.stakes: polishing the visible packet could consume time needed for prevention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: allocate limited attention before action starts

exampleSpecs.audience: delivery managers facing a bad deadline tradeoff
exampleSpecs.stakes: either the date slips or the deliverable ships with a known use gap
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: force the two-bad-options moment where quality changes the decision

exampleSpecs.audience: team members checking a thin quality claim
exampleSpecs.stakes: a team may treat the principle as words instead of shared work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: let two people expose the gap between vocabulary and process evidence

exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may expect test execution to be the source when criteria are the source
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: lead the reader toward a test-capacity explanation, then reveal acceptance criteria as the cause
